caption:
Three practical tools designed to help families navigate the marriage journey with ease.

Make your biodata. Match your kundali. Find your rishta.

RishtaPatra brings three products together: a biodata maker, Janam Kundali (free), and Rishta Connect for matchmaking. Whether you are drafting a biodata, checking compatibility, or exploring rishtas, each tool supports your family step by step.

Note: Kundali calculations are indicative; consult your pandit.

Visit rishtapatra.com to explore.

#RishtaPatra #Biodata #Kundali #Rishta #Family #Marriage
